25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far ahead when the ball was played. De Paul's pass was offside.
25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.intermediate: Just two minutes in, De Paul's pass is flagged offside in France's half, a small early setback for Argentina.
25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.tactical: An offside call in the attacking third at minute 2 suggests Argentina immediately pushed runners in behind France's defensive line, testing their shape early.

545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.basic: A shot on goal means a player kicks the ball toward the net. Mac Allister shot, but the goalkeeper saved it — stopped it with his body.
545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.intermediate: Mac Allister tested the French goalkeeper early in the 2022 final, but the shot was saved, leaving the match goalless.
545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.tactical: An early central shot from Mac Allister probed France's defensive shape at 0-0, but the goalkeeper held firm, denying Argentina an opening-minute advantage.

4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball trying to score a goal. De Paul's shot was blocked by a defender.
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.intermediate: De Paul tested France early with a central strike, but a defender blocked it before it could trouble the goalkeeper.
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.tactical: De Paul's central shot in the 7th minute was intercepted by France's defensive block, preventing any real test of the goalkeeper in the opening phase.

2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.basic: Offside means a player was too far ahead when the ball was played. Tagliafico's pass was cancelled because a teammate was offside.
2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.intermediate: Tagliafico's pass in the attacking third was ruled offside, cutting short an Argentina move while the 2022 final remained 0-0.
2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.tactical: Tagliafico played into the left channel of the attacking third, but Argentina's run timed ahead of the pass broke the offside line, nullifying the progression at 0-0.

6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball trying to score. Di María shot but missed the target.
6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.intermediate: Di María found space inside the penalty area but his shot went off target, wasting a promising chance in a goalless first half.
6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.tactical: Di María receiving centrally inside the box at 0-0 suggested Argentina were exploiting early pressure, but the off-target result squandered a high-value positional opportunity.

6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot on goal from a spot — Messi scored one to give Argentina the lead.
6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.intermediate: Messi converted a penalty to give Argentina a 1-0 lead in the 2022 final, drawing first blood in this historic match.
6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.tactical: Messi's penalty gave Argentina a 1-0 lead in the 2022 final, shifting France into a reactive shape and forcing earlier attacking commitment than planned.

d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead of defenders when the ball is played. Messi was caught offside, so Argentina's attack stopped.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.intermediate: Messi was flagged offside on the right side of France's half, halting an Argentina attack while they led 1-0.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.tactical: Messi triggered the offside trap in the attacking third on the right channel; France's defensive line held its shape to kill the move with Argentina ahead 1-0.

f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.basic: A shot is when a player tries to score a goal. Mac Allister tried to score but missed the target badly.
f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.intermediate: Mac Allister's wayward effort from the left wasted a chance to extend Argentina's 1-0 lead in the final.
f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.tactical: Mac Allister's off-target attempt from a wide-left position in the attacking third suggests a low-probability shooting angle was chosen over a central pass.

ed70825d-8a40-470d-8b30-fd315ab5f0a6.basic: An assist is a pass that leads directly to a goal; Mac Allister made that pass on the right side.
ed70825d-8a40-470d-8b30-fd315ab5f0a6.intermediate: Mac Allister's assist in the attacking third set up a goal, keeping Argentina ahead 1-0 in the first half.
ed70825d-8a40-470d-8b30-fd315ab5f0a6.tactical: Mac Allister's delivery from the right channel of the attacking third created the goal-scoring opportunity that maintained Argentina's 1-0 lead at 35 minutes.

ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.basic: A goal means the ball crosses the line into the net — Di María scored, making it 2-0.
ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.intermediate: Di María's finish doubled Argentina's lead to 2-0 in the first half, giving them a cushion heading into the break.
ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.tactical: Di María's central strike from inside the box to make it 2-0 gives Argentina a two-goal buffer, significantly raising France's recovery burden in the second half.

af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.basic: A yellow card is a warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Enzo Fernandez received a yellow card for a foul in midfield.
af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.intermediate: Fernandez picked up a yellow card for a midfield foul, meaning one more booking ends his match, a risk for Argentina leading 2-0.
af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.tactical: Fernandez's yellow card in midfield compromises Argentina's press and positional discipline; a second booking removes a key engine while protecting a 2-0 lead in the 2022 final.

13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net; a save means the goalkeeper stops it. De Paul shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.intermediate: De Paul threatened France's goal from central range, but the goalkeeper saved it, leaving Argentina's 2-0 lead intact in the second half.
13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.tactical: De Paul's central shot, taken at 2-0 up, was comfortably saved; Argentina showed attacking intent but without converting pressure into a cushion-building third goal.

5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.basic: A yellow card is an official warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Rabiot received a yellow card for a foul in midfield.
5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.intermediate: Rabiot's yellow card for a foul in midfield is a warning — one more means he's sent off, adding pressure on France, trailing 2-0.
5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.tactical: Rabiot's booking in a midfield foul constrains his defensive aggression for the remainder of the match; France, down 2-0, can ill-afford to lose a central midfielder to a second yellow.

43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Álvarez shot; the goalkeeper saved it.
43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.intermediate: Álvarez tested the French goalkeeper from inside the box, but the shot was saved — Argentina stayed at 2-0 and couldn't extend their lead.
43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.tactical: With Argentina leading 2-0, Álvarez attacked the left channel inside the area; the save denied a potential three-goal cushion that would have effectively closed the match.

be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far ahead with fewer than two defenders between them and the goal. France's pass in midfield was ruled offside.
be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.intermediate: France, trailing 2-0, lost possession to an offside call on the left side of midfield, stalling a potential attacking move.
be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.tactical: France attempting to build left-sided through the midfield third; the offside trap nullified the progression, compounding their difficulty in recovering a 2-0 deficit.

9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.basic: A shot is when a player tries to score a goal. Kolo Muani's shot went off target.
9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.intermediate: With France trailing 2-0, Kolo Muani's shot from central penalty area went off target, a wasted chance to cut the deficit.
9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.tactical: France trailing 2-0 need goals urgently; Kolo Muani finds central space inside the area but fails to test the goalkeeper, squandering a high-probability scoring position.

b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball trying to score. Mbappé shot but it went off target.
b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.intermediate: Mbappé's off-target shot from central range leaves France still trailing 2-0 with 20 minutes left to turn the match around.
b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.tactical: With France 2-0 down and time shrinking, Mbappé's central shot missing the frame is a costly waste of a dangerous position; France need precision, not just attempts.

6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot one-on-one with the goalkeeper, awarded for a foul in the box. Mbappé scored. (21 words)
6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.intermediate: Mbappé converted a penalty to make it 2-1, giving France hope after looking dead and buried in the 2022 final. (20 words)
6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.tactical: France's penalty conversion to 2-1 reopened the 2022 final; Argentina's two-goal cushion, built across 79 minutes, was suddenly fragile with time remaining. (23 words)

7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.basic: An assist is the pass that leads directly to a goal. Thuram passed in France's attacking area, setting up a goal.
7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.intermediate: Thuram's assist in the attacking third pulled France level at 2-2, a pivotal shift in the 2022 final.
7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.tactical: With France trailing 2-1, Thuram's central pass in the attacking third unlocked Argentina's defensive shape at a critical stage, enabling the equaliser.

03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.basic: A goal means the ball fully crosses the line into the net. Mbappé scored, making it 2-2.
03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.intermediate: Mbappé's goal levelled it 2-2, dragging France right back into the 2022 final with ten minutes left.
03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.tactical: Mbappé converted centrally inside the box to make it 2-2, erasing Argentina's lead and resetting the game-state pressure entirely in France's favour.

fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.basic: A shot is when a player tries to kick the ball into the goal. Enzo Fernandez's shot was blocked by a defender.
fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.intermediate: Fernandez's blocked shot shows Argentina pushing for a winner at 2-2, unable to restore their lead late in the 2022 final.
fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.tactical: At 2-2 in the 83rd minute, Argentina's central shot from Fernandez was blocked, reflecting their urgency to regain the lead before regulation ended.

8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.basic: A yellow card is a warning given to a player for breaking rules. Thuram received a yellow card for a foul.
8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.intermediate: Thuram's yellow card for a foul inside Argentina's box at 2-2 is a costly caution late in a tense final.
8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.tactical: Thuram booked in the 86th minute at 2-2 limits France's pressing options; a second cautionable offence would reduce them to ten men in a knife-edge final.

22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.basic: Offside means a teammate was in an illegal position ahead of the ball when passed to. Upamecano's pass was called offside.
22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.intermediate: Upamecano's central pass in midfield was ruled offside, halting a France attack at 2-2 with minutes left.
22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.tactical: Upamecano's vertical pass through the centre at 2-2 in the 90th was caught by the offside line — France's build-up reset at a critical moment of pressure.

5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.basic: A shot is when a player tries to score. Mbappé shot at goal, but it was blocked.
5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.intermediate: Mbappé's blocked shot at 2-2 in the 92nd minute kept France from retaking the lead in a dramatic final.
5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.tactical: At 2-2 in the 92nd minute of the 2022 final, Argentina's block denied Mbappé a central chance that could have swung the tie before extra time.

867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Messi shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.intermediate: Messi's shot was saved in extra time with the score 2-2, leaving Argentina unable to retake the lead in the 2022 final.
867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.tactical: At 2-2 in the 96th minute of the 2022 final, Messi attacked centrally but the goalkeeper's save denied Argentina what would have been a decisive lead, keeping the match level.

4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.basic: A yellow card is a warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Acuña fouled an opponent and received a warning.
4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.intermediate: Acuña's foul in the attacking third earned a yellow card at 2-2, a caution that limits his aggression for the rest of this tense final.
4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.tactical: At 2-2 in extra time, Acuña's yellow card in the attacking third is significant — he must now temper his pressing intensity or risk dismissal at a critical juncture.

d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.basic: Extra time means 30 added minutes when the score is tied. Offside means a player was too far forward. Upamecano's pass was ruled offside.
d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.intermediate: Upamecano's offside pass in midfield halts France's attack at 2-2, wasting a precious possession chance deep in extra time.
d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.tactical: France, level at 2-2 and chasing a breakthrough in extra time's first period, lose possession to an offside call on Upamecano's left-channel pass, resetting Argentina's defensive shape.

bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.basic: Offside means a teammate was ahead of defenders when the pass was played; extra time is 30 extra minutes because the match was level; Koundé's pass was offside.
bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.intermediate: Koundé's pass in the right attacking zone is ruled offside at 2-2, wasting a promising France attack in extra time.
bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.tactical: France lose possession to an offside call on the right channel at 2-2; in a stretched extra-time game, that transition opportunity is costly.

d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.basic: A shot is an attempt to score; extra time is 30 bonus minutes after a draw. Lautaro Martínez's shot was blocked by a defender.
d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.intermediate: Martínez couldn't convert from central position at 2-2 in extra time — a blocked shot wastes a golden central chance for Argentina.
d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.tactical: Blocked centrally at 2-2 in extra time's first period; Argentina's failure to convert from the optimal central zone preserves France's survival and prolongs tension.

5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.basic: A shot is when a player tries to score. Extra time is 30 bonus minutes when the score is tied. Lautaro Martínez shot but missed the target.
5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.intermediate: With the 2022 final locked at 2-2 in extra time, Martínez failed to hit the target, wasting a central chance to win it for Argentina.
5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.tactical: At 2-2 in extra time, Martínez found central space inside the box but went off target — a costly miss of a high-probability scoring position for Argentina.

54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.basic: A goal means the ball crosses the opponent's line; extra time is bonus play after a draw. Messi scored for Argentina.
54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.intermediate: Messi's goal put Argentina 3-2 ahead in extra time, giving them the lead in the 2022 final for the first time since the 90 minutes ended level.
54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.tactical: Messi finishing centrally inside the box in the second period of extra time shifted the game-state sharply — Argentina now needed only to defend a 3-2 lead with roughly 13 minutes remaining.

19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.basic: A yellow card is a warning; extra time is 30 added minutes after a tie. Paredes was warned for a foul in midfield.
19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.intermediate: Paredes picked up a yellow card in midfield at 113 minutes, keeping the score 3-2 to Argentina in extra time.
19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.tactical: Paredes's yellow card in the right midfield zone at 3-2 restricts Argentina's physicality in the remaining extra-time minutes, limiting their ability to press or foul again without risking a red.

08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.basic: A shot is an attempt to score. Extra time is 30 bonus minutes. Mbappé tried to score but a defender blocked it.
08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.intermediate: Mbappé's blocked shot in extra time leaves France still trailing 3-2, meaning Argentina remain one goal from winning the 2022 final.
08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.tactical: France desperately need an equaliser at 3-2; Mbappé attacks from the left but the block denies a shot on goal, sustaining Argentina's advantage deep into extra time.

dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.basic: A yellow card is a warning for breaking rules. Extra time is 30 bonus minutes. Montiel was warned for fouling.
dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.intermediate: Montiel's yellow card in extra time keeps Argentina under pressure, protecting their 3-2 lead with the match still alive.
dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.tactical: Montiel's caution in his own half at 3-2 in extra time is significant — a second booking would reduce Argentina to ten men in a fragile winning position.

d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot on goal from the spot; extra time is 30 extra minutes added when level after 90; Mbappé scored, making it 3-3.
d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.intermediate: Mbappé's penalty levelled the 2022 final at 3-3 in extra time, dragging France back from the brink of elimination.
d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.tactical: Mbappé converting from the spot at 117 minutes to make it 3-3 resets the game-state entirely, nullifying Argentina's two-goal cushion built across extra time.

7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead when the ball is played. Messi's pass was ruled offside in extra time — the bonus period after a draw.
7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.intermediate: In extra time of the 2022 final at 3-3, Argentina lose possession when Messi's central pass is flagged offside, halting a potential attack.
7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.tactical: At 3-3 in extra time's second period, Argentina's central passing line is sufficiently advanced that Messi's midfield ball trips the offside trap — surrendering momentum at a critical juncture.

959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.basic: A shot on goal means kicking toward the net; a save means the goalkeeper stopped it. Kolo Muani shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.intermediate: In extra time — added after a 3-3 draw — Kolo Muani's shot was saved, keeping Argentina from winning with seconds remaining.
959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.tactical: At 3-3 deep in extra time, France's best chance to avoid a penalty shootout was denied; the save forced the shootout with enormous psychological consequence for both sides.
